notes: Every screen redrawn. The top bar now belongs to the screen you are on rather than being the same row of statistics everywhere, so Home carries the wordmark, Library a crumb and a plus, and the board the week it is showing. Home lost the folding cover at the top: what is playing lives on the bar above the tabs, one tap from the player, and the space it took now shows what another app is playing and offers to take it over. A room is a screen rather than three cards stacked on Home, and joining one opens it. Your listening has a page of its own, with the minutes, the artists and every entry you can take off. The player, its lyrics and its queue are the surfaces the design drew them as.
